select (select count(1) from t_activity_remark where activity_id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}) + (select count(1) from t_clue where activity_id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}) + (select count(1) from t_customer where activity_id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}) + (select count(1) from t_opportunity o left join t_customer c on o.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER} or o.clue_id in (select id from t_clue where activity_id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER})) + (select count(1) from t_test_drive td left join t_customer c on td.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}) + (select count(1) from t_quote q left join t_customer c on q.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}) + (select count(1) from t_tran t left join t_customer c on t.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER})

select ta.id as activityId, ta.name as activityName, ta.status as status, ta.cost as plannedCost, ta.actual_cost as actualCost, (select count(1) from t_clue c where c.activity_id = ta.id) as clueCount, (select count(1) from t_clue c where c.activity_id = ta.id and c.phone is not null and c.phone != '') as validClueCount, (select count(1) from t_customer c where c.activity_id = ta.id and (c.customer_status is null or c.customer_status != 'MERGED')) as customerCount, (select count(distinct o.id) from t_opportunity o left join t_customer c on o.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = ta.id or o.clue_id in (select id from t_clue where activity_id = ta.id)) as opportunityCount, (select count(distinct td.id) from t_test_drive td left join t_customer c on td.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = ta.id) as testDriveCount, (select count(distinct q.id) from t_quote q left join t_customer c on q.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = ta.id) as quoteCount, (select count(distinct t.id) from t_tran t left join t_customer c on t.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = ta.id and t.stage not in ('CANCELLED', 'LOST', 'CLOSED')) as orderCount, coalesce((select sum(t.money) from t_tran t left join t_customer c on t.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = ta.id and t.stage = 'COMPLETED'), 0) as dealAmount, case when coalesce(ta.actual_cost, ta.cost, 0) = 0 then null else round((coalesce((select sum(t.money) from t_tran t left join t_customer c on t.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = ta.id and t.stage = 'COMPLETED'), 0) - coalesce(ta.actual_cost, ta.cost, 0)) / coalesce(ta.actual_cost, ta.cost, 0), 4) end as roi from t_activity ta where ta.id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}
and ta.owner_id = #{dataScopeUserId,jdbcType=INTEGER}

select ta.id as activityId, ta.name as activityName, case ta.status when 'DRAFT' then '草稿' when 'PLANNED' then '待开始' when 'ONGOING' then '进行中' when 'ENDED' then '已结束' when 'REVIEWED' then '已复盘' when 'CLOSED' then '已关闭' when 'CANCELED' then '已取消' else ta.status end as statusName, tu.name as ownerName, ta.channel as channel, ta.target_model as targetModel, ta.cost as plannedCost, ta.actual_cost as actualCost, (select count(1) from t_clue c where c.activity_id = ta.id) as clueCount, (select count(1) from t_customer c where c.activity_id = ta.id and (c.customer_status is null or c.customer_status != 'MERGED')) as customerCount, (select count(distinct o.id) from t_opportunity o left join t_customer c on o.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = ta.id or o.clue_id in (select id from t_clue where activity_id = ta.id)) as opportunityCount, (select count(distinct td.id) from t_test_drive td left join t_customer c on td.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = ta.id) as testDriveCount, (select count(distinct q.id) from t_quote q left join t_customer c on q.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = ta.id) as quoteCount, (select count(distinct t.id) from t_tran t left join t_customer c on t.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = ta.id and t.stage not in ('CANCELLED', 'LOST', 'CLOSED')) as orderCount, coalesce((select sum(t.money) from t_tran t left join t_customer c on t.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = ta.id and t.stage = 'COMPLETED'), 0) as dealAmount, case when coalesce(ta.actual_cost, ta.cost, 0) = 0 then null else round((coalesce((select sum(t.money) from t_tran t left join t_customer c on t.customer_id = c.id where c.activity_id = ta.id and t.stage = 'COMPLETED'), 0) - coalesce(ta.actual_cost, ta.cost, 0)) / coalesce(ta.actual_cost, ta.cost, 0), 4) end as roi, ta.result_summary as resultSummary from t_activity ta left join t_user tu on ta.owner_id = tu.id
order by ta.start_time desc, ta.id desc
